description: Recover the original frontend source code from commit 663d43b0 and replace the current barebones apps/frontend/ with the full-featured original. This involves extracting all files from artifacts/syrabit/ at that commit, placing src/ content into apps/frontend/src/, and bringing over all supporting config files (vite.config.js, tailwind.config.js, vitest.config.js, index.html, postcss.config.cjs, vite-plugins/, scripts/).
steps: Step 1: Remove the current barebones src/ directory at apps/frontend/src/ (it only has App.tsx, main.tsx, components/hooks with basic chat files, vite-env.d.ts, App.css, index.css)

Step 2: Extract the original source from commit 663d43b0 using: git checkout 663d43b0 -- artifacts/syrabit/src/ (this restores the 377-file src/ tree into the working directory at artifacts/syrabit/src/)
Step 3: Move/copy the recovered artifacts/syrabit/src/ directory to apps/frontend/src/ (replacing what was there)
Step 4: Extract the original vite.config.js from commit 663d43b0: git show 663d43b0:artifacts/syrabit/vite.config.js > apps/frontend/vite.config.js (remove the old vite.config.ts)
Step 5: Extract the original tailwind.config.js: git show 663d43b0:artifacts/syrabit/tailwind.config.js > apps/frontend/tailwind.config.js
Step 6: Extract the original postcss.config.cjs: git show 663d43b0:artifacts/syrabit/postcss.config.cjs > apps/frontend/postcss.config.cjs (remove old postcss.config.js)
Step 7: Extract the original vitest.config.js: git show 663d43b0:artifacts/syrabit/vitest.config.js > apps/frontend/vitest.config.js
Step 8: Extract the original index.html: git show 663d43b0:artifacts/syrabit/index.html > apps/frontend/index.html
Step 9: Extract the original tsconfig.json: git show 663d43b0:artifacts/syrabit/tsconfig.json > apps/frontend/tsconfig.json
Step 10: Extract the vite-plugins/ directory: git checkout 663d43b0 -- artifacts/syrabit/vite-plugins/ then move artifacts/syrabit/vite-plugins/ to apps/frontend/vite-plugins/
Step 11: Extract the scripts/ directory: git checkout 663d43b0 -- artifacts/syrabit/scripts/ then move artifacts/syrabit/scripts/ to apps/frontend/scripts/
Step 12: Extract the public/ directory (PWA icons, manifest, sw.js, etc.): git checkout 663d43b0 -- artifacts/syrabit/public/ then move artifacts/syrabit/public/ to apps/frontend/public/
Step 13: Clean up the artifacts/syrabit/ directory that was temporarily restored (rm -rf artifacts/syrabit/)
Step 14: Remove old TypeScript-specific files that are no longer needed: apps/frontend/vite.config.ts, apps/frontend/tsconfig.node.json, apps/frontend/postcss.config.js (replaced by .cjs)
acceptance_criteria: apps/frontend/src/ contains the full 377-file original source tree (App.jsx, index.jsx, pages/, components/, context/, hooks/, lib/, utils/, etc.)
apps/frontend/vite.config.js exists and contains the original config with @/ path alias, bot render plugin, chunk splitting, etc.
apps/frontend/tailwind.config.js contains the full 140-line original config with CSS variable-based color tokens
apps/frontend/index.html contains the full original with SEO meta, JSON-LD, PWA hints, pre-hydration shell
apps/frontend/vite-plugins/ directory exists with codemirror-stub.js, modulepreload-inject.js, preload-headers-inject.js
apps/frontend/scripts/ directory exists with build scripts
apps/frontend/public/ directory exists with PWA assets
The old vite.config.ts, tsconfig.node.json are removed
verification: Run: ls apps/frontend/src/App.jsx apps/frontend/src/index.jsx apps/frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.jsx apps/frontend/src/pages/LibraryPage.jsx apps/frontend/src/pages/BrowserPage.jsx apps/frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx apps/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx - all should exist
Run: ls apps/frontend/vite.config.js apps/frontend/tailwind.config.js apps/frontend/vitest.config.js apps/frontend/index.html - all should exist
Run: ls apps/frontend/vite-plugins/ - should list 3 plugin files
Run: wc -l apps/frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.jsx - should be ~900+ lines
Run: find apps/frontend/src -name '*.jsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.ts' | wc -l - should be 370+
findings: Successfully recovered 375 source files (jsx/js/css/ts) from commit 663d43b0. ChatPage.jsx is 906 lines. All config files (vite.config.js, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.cjs, vitest.config.js, index.html, tsconfig.json) extracted. vite-plugins/ has 3 files, scripts/ has 33 files, public/ has PWA assets. Old TS configs (vite.config.ts, tsconfig.node.json, postcss.config.js) removed. artifacts/syrabit/ cleaned up. The artifacts/ directory still contains mockup-sandbox/ which is unrelated.
